description: React component for displaying and managing linked item bubbles with autocomplete and keyboard navigation.

methods.name: isItemBidirectionallyLinked
methods.description: Checks if a link is bidirectionally linked based on item UUIDs and content type.

methods.name: activateItemAndTogglePane
methods.description: Activates an item and toggles the app pane accordingly.

methods.name: focusPreviousItem
methods.description: Focuses the previous item in the focusable list.

methods.name: focusNextItem
methods.description: Focuses the next item in the focusable list.
